raw_text:
name: python-guide
Python 3.11+; APIs, CLIs, Data Pipelines, Automation.
- All function signatures, class attributes, and module-level variables must have type annotations.
- No `*` imports, no mutable default arguments, no implicit type coercions.
- Never install into system Python; use `venv`, `uv`, or `poetry`.
- Use pytest for all testing; fixtures and parametrize over setUp/tearDown.
- Enforce style mechanically; never rely on manual formatting.
- Target Python 3.11+
